newsitem.title: UK: (REPEAT) FTSE 100 ends at record peak for second session.
newsitem.headline: (REPEAT) FTSE 100 ends at record peak for second session.

text.p: UK share prices climbed to record highs on Monday as Friday's surge on Wall Street rippled over the Atlantic, boosting investor confidence here, traders said. The FTSE 100 index of leading shares settled 6.7 up at 4,031.5 points. But profit-taking in gilts, T-bonds and in U.S. stocks knocked the index off the day's earlier high of 4,046.8.
JP Morgan's European equity strategist Gary Dugan said he increased his weighting on UK stocks to "neutral" from "underweight," and raised his target for the FTSE 100 to 4,300.
"But there's every reason to believe the market can reach 4,300 before the (British general) election," Dugan said.
The ruling Conservative Party must call an election by May next year.
